title: Delivery App Development Cost in India
seoTitle: Delivery App Development Cost in India (2026)
seoDescription: What a custom delivery and logistics app costs in India: rider app, dispatch, live tracking, proof of delivery, COD. Cost bands, timelines and drivers.
summary: A custom delivery app in India typically costs ₹6 lakh to ₹15 lakh for a rider app with dispatch, tracking and proof of delivery for your own fleet, ₹15 lakh to ₹35 lakh for a customer app, route optimisation and multi-hub operations, and more for on-demand marketplaces.

costBands.includes: Rider app, dispatch panel, live tracking, photo and OTP proof of delivery, COD records
Customer app, route optimisation, hub transfers, returns, analytics
Three-sided marketplace, payments and payouts, surge rules, support tools

dataPoints.label: Biggest cost drivers
dataPoints.value: Real-time tracking, route optimisation, number of apps (rider, customer, admin)

dataPoints.label: Running costs
dataPoints.value: Maps API usage, SMS/WhatsApp, hosting; maps can be significant at volume

dataPoints.label: Must-haves
dataPoints.value: Offline tolerance, battery-efficient location, proof of delivery

dataPoints.label: Integrations
dataPoints.value: Order systems, ERP, payment gateway, courier partners

body:
## What moves the price

- Live tracking and ETA accuracy.
- Route optimisation across many stops.
- COD reconciliation and rider payouts.

See [delivery and logistics apps: features that matter](/blog/delivery-and-logistics-apps-features-that-matter).

These ranges are indicative for 2026, based on the effort such projects typically take. Your quote depends on your scope, integrations and quality requirements; a short discovery phase turns this into a firm number.

faqs.q: Should we build or use a logistics SaaS?
faqs.a: For standard last-mile needs, SaaS is faster. Custom suits unusual workflows or deep integration with your operations.
It depends on requests per delivery; design choices such as caching and batching reduce it a lot.
